SELECT GROUP_CODE AS groupCd, GROUP_NM AS groupNm FROM DOCS_ROLE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_CODE = #{groupCd} AND GROUP_CODE NOT IN ('RG_006', 'RG_001') AND USE_YN = 'Y'

WITH RECURSIVE active_menu (menu_cd, parent_menu_cd, role_cd, path) AS ( SELECT menu.menu_cd, menu.parent_menu_cd, menu.role_cd, ARRAY[menu.menu_cd::TEXT]::TEXT[] FROM docs_menu menu WHERE menu.del_yn = 'N' AND menu.use_yn = 'Y' AND menu.menu_type IN ('T', 'M', 'P') AND menu.tree_type = 'root' AND menu.parent_menu_cd = 'ROOT' UNION ALL SELECT child.menu_cd, child.parent_menu_cd, child.role_cd, parent.path || child.menu_cd::TEXT FROM docs_menu child JOIN active_menu parent ON child.parent_menu_cd = parent.menu_cd WHERE child.del_yn = 'N' AND child.use_yn = 'Y' AND child.menu_type IN ('T', 'M', 'P') AND NOT child.menu_cd::TEXT = ANY(parent.path) ) SELECT menu.menu_cd FROM active_menu menu JOIN docs_rel_role_group rel ON rel.role_cd = menu.role_cd WHERE rel.group_cd = #{groupCd} ORDER BY menu.menu_cd

WITH RECURSIVE active_menu (menu_cd, parent_menu_cd, role_cd, path) AS ( SELECT menu.menu_cd, menu.parent_menu_cd, menu.role_cd, ARRAY[menu.menu_cd::TEXT]::TEXT[] FROM docs_menu menu WHERE menu.del_yn = 'N' AND menu.use_yn = 'Y' AND menu.menu_type IN ('T', 'M', 'P') AND menu.tree_type = 'root' AND menu.parent_menu_cd = 'ROOT' UNION ALL SELECT child.menu_cd, child.parent_menu_cd, child.role_cd, parent.path || child.menu_cd::TEXT FROM docs_menu child JOIN active_menu parent ON child.parent_menu_cd = parent.menu_cd WHERE child.del_yn = 'N' AND child.use_yn = 'Y' AND child.menu_type IN ('T', 'M', 'P') AND NOT child.menu_cd::TEXT = ANY(parent.path) ) SELECT DISTINCT role_cd FROM active_menu WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(role_cd), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY role_cd
mapper.insert: /* REL_ROLE_GROUP을 등록 */ INSERT INTO DOCS_REL_ROLE_GROUP (GROUP_CD, ROLE_CD, INSERT_DT) VALUES (#{groupCd}, #{roleCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (GROUP_CD, ROLE_CD) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DOCS_REL_ROLE_GROUP assignment USING DOCS_MENU menu WHERE assignment.GROUP_CD = #{groupCd} AND (assignment.ROLE_CD = menu.ROLE_CD OR assignment.ROLE_CD = menu.MENU_CD)
